title: Fake Thesis Editing Service
scenario: An editor guarantees a passing grade and asks for your login to upload changes.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Fake Thesis Editing Service: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Do not share academic system logins with vendors.
